violations.description: Duties of person in charge. — --Person in charge did not ensure employee compliance with an aspect of the food service operation specified in the food service code. Employees found using the hot hold cabinet to heat food items. This cabinet is not intended to heat items, only to maintain temperatures. Person in charge did not ensure employees were aware of proper heating procedures.

Preventing contamination by employees. — --Employee's single-use gloves were not discarded after being damaged or soiled. Food employee was observed touching her clothing with gloved hands, and did not change gloves. Gloves should be changed after handling personal items.

Reheating food. — --Potentially hazardous food was not reheated rapidly so all parts reached a temperature of 165F for 15 seconds within one hour. Alfredo sauce, placed in warming cabinet directly from the cooler to heat, was found at 100F after being in the warming cabinet for more than 1 hour. Potentially hazardous food items should be reheated to 165F with-in 1 hour. **Sauce was discarded.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder or bar soap. Hand soap was not available at the hand washing sink near the front pizza prep area. Soap should be provided at all times.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Ceiling vents were found dirty throughout the kitchen. These should be cleaned and maintained clean.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Flooring near the double pizza oven was found with cardboard covering areas were the seal on the floor has worn and the flooring is peeling back. Flooring should be maintained so it is smooth and easily cleanable.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --Employees' clothing/possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. Employee purse was found on rolling cart near back food prep area. Personal items should be stored away from food prep areas.

Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. Container of chopped lettuce in the refrigerated prep table was found with two bottles of Ceasar dressing on top of the lettuce. Dressing bottles should not be stored in the same container as the lettuce in order to protect the lettuce from contamination.

Time as a public health control. — --Food was not marked or identified with the time within which it must be cooked, served, or discarded. Pizzas on display, using time as a control, were not marked with the cooked or discard time. When using time as a control, the time the item was prepared or the time to discard must be marked.

General equipment and utensils - Use limitations of certain materials. — --Material of food contact equipment/utensil did not meet durability characteristics or are a limited use material. Single-use portion cup was found in the container of croutons on the cook line. These single-use items are not designed for reuse and should not be used as scoops. A spoon or other serving utensil with a long handle should be used for dispensing food items.
Method, clean, temp, concentration, exposure time, equipment/utensils sanitized (4 pts deducted)
Number, location, accessibility, soap and paper towels provided (3 pts deducted)
Date marking accomplished, discarded (2 pts deducted)
Properly designed, located, constructed, operated, maintained, cleaned and chemical test kit provided (2 pts deducted)
Hot holding and cold holding temperatures maintained, unwrapped food not reserved (5 pts deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (2 pts deducted)
